populationDefinition: exactly the 12 V151 positive-consensus event indices

strengthClasses.both-selected: selected note has more local exact-pitch recurrence AND more local pitch-class recurrence than the accepted/original note
strengthClasses.one-selected: exactly one recurrence channel favors selected and the other is tied
strengthClasses.both-tied: both recurrence channels are tied; support comes only from two-sided voice-leading

purpose: Separate active local recurrence support for the selected note from mere absence of contrary recurrence evidence, while preserving the already-frozen two-sided voice-leading requirement.
nextBoundary: If both-selected cases exist, a separate frozen construction phase may create exactly one accepted-baseline-plus-both-selected candidate and no alternate class combination.
